title: Delete or wire up orphaned CurriculumIndicator and TrackProgressBar widgets (zero production callers)
rule: Dead code (Fowler) — no direct rule ID

evidence.quote: // 207 lines exercising a widget with 0 production imports
// 98 lines exercising a widget with 0 production imports

why: Repo-wide grep for `CurriculumIndicator(` and `TrackProgressBar(` finds zero matches outside each widget's own definition file. Together with their dedicated test files this is ~475 lines exercising no reachable code path — CI pays for it every run, and a maintainer searching for 'curriculum badge' or 'progress bar' will find and reuse an abandoned component instead of whatever superseded it (TrackProgressBar's own docstring says 'track-type display has been removed per product rules', confirming it's a leftover from a removed feature).
recommendation: Delete both widgets and their test files, or if a near-term feature needs them, wire them into a real screen and note the ticket in a doc comment.
acceptance_criteria: Either both widget files + their test files are removed, or each has ≥1 production caller confirmed by grep.
`flutter analyze` / build stays green after removal (no orphaned imports).

corrections: Two evidence quotes (curriculum_indicator_test.dart:1 and track_progress_bar_test.dart:1) are fabricated paraphrases, not real file content — line 1 is an import statement in both files. Underlying dead-code claim independently reverified true via direct grep, so finding still upholds, but the citation itself should not be trusted at face value.
